items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Earnings Beat And Dividend Hike Put Valuation Back In Focus
items.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) just put fresh numbers on the table with its third quarter 2026 earnings, pairing higher reported revenue and net income with updated production guidance and an 11% dividend increase. That backdrop has kept ConocoPhillips in focus, with the share price up 15.9% over the past 90 days and 40.9% year to date, even though the 7 day share price return declined 11.5% and short term momentum cooled ahead of this earnings release. items.title: ConocoPhillips Just Raised Its Dividend 11%. Is It a Better Buy Than Murphy Oil?
items.summary: Two oil producers just posted strong quarters, but only one turned its cash flow into a payout that can survive a price slump. For income investors, the gap between a bigger yield and a safer check may surprise you.
